title: $1.77 EPS Expected for NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NXPI)
text:
$1.77 EPS Expected for NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NXPI) Posted by Hazel Jackson 15 am
Analysts expect NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) to report $1.77 EPS on February, 6.They anticipate $1.29 EPS change or 42.16 % from last quarter’s $3.06 EPS. NXPI’s profit would be $523.05 million giving it 10.66 P/E if the $1.77 EPS is correct. After having $1.81 EPS previously, NXP Semiconductors N.V.’s analysts see -2.21 % EPS growth. The stock increased 4.84% or $3.48 during the last trading session, reaching $75.45. About 4.87M shares traded. NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) has declined 33.99% since January 5, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 33.99% the S&P500. NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) Ratings Coverage
Among 16 analysts covering NXP Semiconductors ( NASDAQ:NXPI ), 10 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 5 Hold. Therefore 63% are positive. NXP Semiconductors had 20 analyst reports since July 26, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. Stifel Nicolaus downgraded the shares of NXPI in report on Wednesday, September 12 to “Sell” rating. On Friday, July 27 the stock rating was upgraded by Mizuho to “Buy”. The firm earned “Outperform” rating on Friday, September 7 by Credit Suisse. Barclays Capital upgraded it to “Overweight” rating and $95 target in Tuesday, October 23 report. Stifel Nicolaus maintained the shares of NXPI in report on Friday, July 27 with “Hold” rating. The rating was upgraded by Jefferies to “Buy” on Friday, July 27. Bank of America upgraded the stock to “Buy” rating in Monday, September 17 report. The rating was upgraded by Goldman Sachs on Thursday, October 18 to “Buy”. The firm has “Equal-Weight” rating given on Wednesday, October 3 by Morgan Stanley. On Friday, July 27 the stock rating was maintained by BMO Capital Markets with “Market Perform”.
NXP Semiconductors N.V., a semiconductor company, provides high performance mixed signal and standard product solutions for radio frequency , analog, power management, interface, security, and digital processing products worldwide. The company has market cap of $22.30 billion. It offers products for audio and visual head-end unit applications, such as single-chip radio solutions, audio amplifiers and power analog products, and i.MX applications processors; and in-vehicle networking products, two-way secure entry products, and various sensors and microcontrollers, as well as power management solutions. It has a 9.6 P/E ratio. The firm also provides secure identification solutions comprising passive RF connectivity devices; microcontroller devices; and secure real-time operating system software products to facilitate the encryption-decryption of data, and the interaction with the reader infrastructure systems.
